sql:
SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName,
    sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 1) AS ActualRevenue,
    sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 2) AS BudgetRevenue,
    sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 1) - sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 2) AS Variance,
    (sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 1) - sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 2))
        * 100.0 / nullif(sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 2), 0) AS VariancePct
FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan sp
JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc
    ON sp.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
WHERE toYear(sp.DateKey) = 2009
  AND sp.ScenarioKey IN (1, 2)
  AND sp.AccountKey = 50
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY ActualRevenue DESC
